exercises.hint: average = (a + b) / 2 — and don't forget to return it.
exercises.task: Complete average(a, b) so it returns the mean of the two numbers.

exercises.hint: const double = n => n * 2; — then call double(7) and print it.
exercises.task: Rewrite double as an arrow function and print double(7).

exercises.task: Build a counter closure: each call returns the next number.
